status: implemented pending full admission; focused executed GEMP comparisons

findings: Lift Tube is enclosed, carries four passengers and never counts as unpiloted. It may exist only at interior mobile sites.
Moving the vehicle consumes its regular move and carries its passengers without using their regular moves.
React permits predeparture boarding and postarrival disembarking. Arrival with presence cancels the drain; empty arrival supplies no presence.
Laser Gate permits passage in a Lift Tube. This interaction is native-only because the pinned reference has no Laser Gate implementation.

nativeScope: Both prints deploy for 1 Force at legal interior mobile sites with ordinary deployment presence.
Four passenger-only slots, enclosed presence and battle contribution rules, no fabricated pilot or ability.
Driverless regular movement and either-side reaction use the existing durable payment, response and intermediate-arrival pipeline.
Capacity recovery rejects fifth passengers and forged driver/pilot assignments. Never-exist rules reject nonmobile/exterior-only/system and cargo placements, including while text is suppressed.
Carried battle passengers retain postarrival disembarking permission after current-battle participation history is recorded. Prior-react participants remain ineligible.
Weak passengers traverse Laser Gate while aboard Lift Tube; gate-crossing is verified natively and in browser, not claimed as GEMP parity.
